answer: A farm running 171 keys hence forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. Because the timber stake is held until the trellis settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the forge audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 19% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
